## Checklist

- [ ] Build passes: `npm run build`
- [ ] Content checks pass: `npm run content:check`
- [ ] Lint & types pass: `npm run lint && npm run typecheck`
- [ ] Tests pass: `npm test && npm run test:e2e`
- [ ] Images have alt text and reasonable sizes
- [ ] AI-generated content includes citations
- [ ] Briefs/case studies follow schema (frontmatter fields present)
